'''Rujos''' were silver-furred, herd-dwelling quadrupeds from [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] spread to [[Qina/Legends|Qina]] and other [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] worlds as domestic animals for carrying cargo or riders.<ref name="Gamer 9" />
